content:wysiwyg_basic:2:83.name: WYSIWYG
content:wysiwyg_basic:2:83.html:
We feed the hungry, shelter the homeless and bring hope to the dispirited.

Poverty is so often the result of and the catalyst for chronic struggles with hunger, addiction, housing insecurity, mental illness, unemployment, educational voids and various forms of abuse. These interconnected struggles continue year after year, and often span generations. That's Why The Salvation Army works to meet the needs of the whole person through short and long-term assistance first alleviating the symptoms of poverty and then addressing the root issues that cause it.

Utility Assistance

We help struggling families and individuals avoid falling into the cycle of crisis by supplementing their income with utility assistance. This service often becomes the difference between going hungry or being evicted.

Seasonal Assistance

During certain times of the year, there is assistance available to meet a specific seasonally based need. Seasonal assistance consists of help with a Winter Coat giveaway and toys for children in need at Christmas.

The Salvation Army Of Gwinnett Family and Social Services & Programs:

  • Financial Emergency Services: Utilities, Mortgage & Rental Assistance

  • Sally’s Emergency Market: Toiletries, comfort kits, ready-to-eat meals & shelf stable food.

  • Home Sweet Home Gwinnett: Hotel/Motel Vouchers; Assistance with permanent housing solutions & self-sufficiency.

  • Men Ministry and Youth Ministries

  • Angel Tree

  • Nursery

    We offer free childcare every Wednesday night and Sunday morning for those who are participating in our worship programs. Your child will have the opportunity to play, explore, and learn with other kids their age. To use our childcare, just stop at the front desk when you arrive.

  • Thrive

    Kindergarden - 5th Grade

    Wednesdays at 6:30 pm

  • Reverb

    Wednesdays at 6:30 PM

    Reverb is a place where 6th-12th graders can come and build long-lasting friendships while exploring their relationship with God.
    ​Reverb meets every Wednesday at 6:30 pm.

  • Music and Arts

    Thursdays at 6:15 PM

  • Life Groups

    Wednesdays at 6:15-7:30 PM (offered in both English and Spanish)

    Life Groups are an opportunity for adult fellowship and discipleship with your church community. You will explore portions of the Bible together, as you discover how the Bible applies to your life right now. Through videos and questions, you will study God's words and His character, allowing you to better understand Him and your purpose.     God has something to tell you today, will you listen?

  • Bible Study

    Wednesdays at 6:30 PM

    Our mid-week Bible Study is a safe place for anyone to explore the Bible with others who are doing the same thing. Regardless if you have studied the Bible your entire life, or are brand new to the Bible, this class will give you the tools needed to help understand and apply the stories and lessons of the Bible to our lives.

Request Family and Social Services Information

content:wysiwyg_basic:20:79.html:
Grupos de Vida

Miércoles
6:15 - 7:30 Pm

Los Grupos de Vida son una oportunidad para la comunión y el discipulado de adultos dentro de tu comunidad de iglesia. Explorarás Juntos porciones de la Biblia, descubriendo cómo se aplica a tu vida en este momento. A través de videos y preguntas, estudiarás la palabra de Dios y Su carácter, para entender mejor a Él y a tu propósito.

Dios tiene algo que decirte hoy, ¿escucharás?
